summary_md: **cv usk ([@cv_usk](https://x.com/cv_usk/status/2116473504656986536))** explains *AgentBaton* by Li et al. ([arXiv 2610.35959](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.35959)): a capable model does the heavy lifting, then a lightweight detector (from Qwen 3.5 2B) hands off to a cheaper model once only local finishing work remains, cutting API cost about 66% on average with accuracy largely preserved and beating per-turn routing.

referenced_urls.title: AgentBaton: Efficient Model Collaboration in Agentic Tasks

relevance: Mid-task model handoff for cheaper agents.
